title: feat(studio): package lifecycle UI — Duplicate / Adopt loose items / structure-only delete (ADR-0070 D4/D5/D6)
body:
## What
The Studio user-facing affordances for ADR-0070 D4/D5/D6, wired to the kernel/API shipped in [framework#2299](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2299) (duplicate) and [framework#2301](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2301) (adopt-orphans).

`PackageDetailSheet`:
- **Duplicate** → `POST /packages/:id/duplicate` (clone a base into a new writable package — D4).
- **Adopt loose items** → `POST /packages/:id/adopt-orphans` (migrate package-less orphans into this base — D5).
- **Delete** now asks whether to also drop records (`?keepData`) — structure-only vs everything (D4 Q3).
- **D6** guardrail test: the scope selector never defaults to the package-less `Local / Custom` sentinel.

## Tests
`@object-ui/app-shell`: 500 metadata-admin tests green (incl. new D6 guardrail); `tsc` clean. (Browser verification of the new buttons is a light follow-up.)

Completes the ADR-0070 D4/D5/D6 surface. Phase 6 (automated dogfood gate) is the last item.
